title: Myopathy Registry Berlin
summary:
Myopathies are a heterogeneous group of rare diseases of the skeletal muscles. Pathophysiologically, acquired (autoimmune-inflammatory) muscle diseases can be distinguished from genetically determined (e.g. dystrophic) muscle diseases. Depending on the respective disease, muscular (e.g. paresis, muscle atrophy) and extramuscular symptoms can occur (e.g.
cardiomyopathy, skin involvement, lung involvement). Due to the rarity and complexity of the diseases, care is not available
Affected patients regularly take place at university outpatient clinics or university hospitals. In the consultation hours for muscle diseases
Every year, several hundred patients with myopathies are treated at the Charité's neurological university outpatient clinic. The patients will
interdisciplinary outpatient and inpatient care.

interventions.name: All standardized, systematically collected interdisciplinary clinical and paraclinical data of patients with myopathies who present at the outpatient clinic for muscle diseases of the Charité Neurological University Outpatient Clinic are recorded in a register, if consent is given.
